source_issues.title: My Pro Subscription is not reflected in the Tier
source_issues.evidence: Google AI Pro subscription not reflected in CLI tier — shows only Google Assist. Screenshot attached. Other Google ecosystem products correctly show Pro status. User explicitly expects Pro status and Pro-related quotas.

signals.topic: /chat command extremely slow with large session histories (25s–60s+ load time)
signals.summary: Loading session history via /chat command takes 25+ seconds on a 59-session/2.3GB benchmark, with real-world daily use exceeding 60 seconds, making the feature practically unusable.
signals.review_reason: Significant performance degradation that renders a core feature (/chat — session history browsing) practically unusable. Load times of 25–60+ seconds are far outside acceptable UX thresholds. Single report but with precise benchmark data, identified root causes, and a confirmed fix (634ms vs 25.62s = 40x improvement), indicating a real and significant bug. Not P0 because it does not block the primary agent workflow — only the history browsing sub-feature.

source_issues.title: /chat command loading extremely slow with large histories (60s+)
source_issues.evidence: Benchmark: 59 sessions / 2.3GB of JSONL takes 25.62s on a fresh environment, and exceeds 60s in daily accumulated use. Root causes identified: readline streaming entire files for metadata, one subprocess per file for line counting, multi-megabyte backward scan for summary field. Reporter has complete fix reducing load time to 634ms (40x improvement).

signals.topic: Sudo password typed in clear text and leaked to LLM due to missing terminal focus
signals.summary: When a sudo command requires a password prompt, keyboard focus remains on the chat input field. Users naturally type their password, which appears in clear text in the chat input and is sent to the LLM — leaking system credentials to the model and potentially into logs.
signals.review_reason: Critical security vulnerability with clear user impact: system credentials are actively leaked to the LLM and potentially stored in logs. The issue is reproducible on any sudo command requiring a password. The reporter explicitly labels it SECURITY/UX with priority/p1. This is a P1 because while it is a single report, the security severity is high (credential exfiltration) and the attack surface is broad (any sudo command).

source_issues.title: [SECURITY/UX] Password leak risk due to lack of auto-focus for sudo commands
source_issues.evidence: Security/UX issue: when sudo password prompt appears, focus stays on chat input. Password typed in clear text in chat input and sent to LLM. Reporter labels it priority/p1 and area/security. Model may store credentials in logs. Reproducible by running any sudo command that requires a password.

signals.topic: useCustomTools incorrectly resolves to false with Vertex AI auth, blocking custom tools
signals.summary: When using Vertex AI authentication, the useCustomTools flag is incorrectly set to false, causing the model to resolve to gemini-3.1-pro-preview instead of gemini-3.1-pro-preview-customtools, which is the documented default for Vertex AI.
signals.review_reason: Key functionality (custom tools) is incorrectly disabled for all Vertex AI auth users. The bug is in a single config branch and the fix is trivial (one-line change). Single report but with precise root-cause identification, a specific code location, and an exact proposed fix — high confidence bug with clear user impact on a feature-critical code path.

source_issues.title: useCustomTools incorrectly resolves to 'false' with Vertex auth
source_issues.evidence: With Vertex AI auth configured, model resolves to 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview' instead of 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview-customtools'. Root cause identified at a specific line in config.ts (L3478). Reporter provides exact code fix. Vertex AI documentation confirms customtools model is available on Vertex.

signals.topic: Windows users cannot install smolagents[dev] due to mlx[cpu] having no Windows wheels (uv dependency resolution failure)
signals.summary: Windows users attempting `uv pip install -e "smolagents[dev] @ ."` encounter an unsatisfiable dependency error because mlx[cpu] provides no win_amd64 wheels, blocking local development setup entirely on Windows.
aliases: smolagents dev install fails on windows uv
signals.review_reason: 用户尝试在 Windows 上安装 smolagents[dev] 时主流程被完全阻断,依赖解析失败且无可行替代方案,属于 P1 级别的安装阻断问题。

source_issues.title: BUG:  No solution found when resolving dependencies while uv
source_issues.evidence: Windows user on Python 3.11 and 3.12 both get 'No solution found when resolving dependencies: smolagents[dev]==1.25.0.dev0 depends on mlx[cpu], we can conclude that smolagents[dev]==1.25.0.dev0 cannot be used.' Root cause: mlx[cpu] has no win_amd64 wheels.

signals.topic: f-string double-brace bug in ToolSerializer.dumps produces literal '{e}' instead of actual exception message
signals.summary: In serialization.py line 429, the f-string uses double braces `{{e}}` which renders a literal `{e}` string instead of interpolating the exception variable, making SerializationError messages uninformative and preventing users from diagnosing serialization failures.
signals.review_reason: 序列化失败时用户看到的错误信息包含字面量 '{e}' 而非实际异常内容,属于运行时体验下降问题。虽然 count=1,review_reason 确认有明确用户影响(错误信息不可用,无法诊断问题),因此保留为 P2。

source_issues.title: BUG: f-string escape error in ToolSerializer.dumps causes uninformative error message
source_issues.evidence: Code on line 429 uses f"Cannot serialize object: {{e}}" which produces literal '{e}' instead of the exception value. Line 292 in the same file has the correct single-brace form. Users see 'Cannot serialize object: {e}' with no actual error context.

signals.topic: CI test assertion for missing-credential error messages uses hardcoded phrase list that misses Cerebras provider error format
signals.summary: The test_call_different_providers_without_key test checks for specific error phrases but the Cerebras provider returns 'Missing credentials' (a credential error) that doesn't match any of the expected phrases, causing CI to fail.
aliases: Cerebras missing credentials test assertion failure
LiteLLMModel test fails cerebras no matching error phrase
signals.review_reason: CI 测试因断言短语列表不完整而失败,属于工作流阻断问题。但这是内部测试失败而非用户主流程阻断,且影响范围仅限于 CI 环境,保留为 P2。

source_issues.title: CI fails: CerebrasException - Missing credentials
source_issues.evidence: Test expects one of ['Missing API Key', 'Wrong API Key', 'Invalid API Key', 'The api_key client option must be set', 'AuthenticationError', 'Unauthorized'] but Cerebras returns 'CerebrasException - Missing credentials' which matches the same semantic error but not the exact phrasing, causing AssertionError and CI failure.

signals.topic: MCP pre-flight HEAD request silently drops authentication headers, causing all authenticated MCP servers to fail pre-flight and be skipped
signals.summary: DeepAgents' MCP pre-flight check (`_check_remote_server` in `mcp_tools.py`) sends a HEAD request without passing the configured auth headers from the server config. This causes all authenticated MCP servers (requiring API keys or tokens) to return HTTP 500 and be silently skipped. No workaround exists without manual patching. This is a complete functional breakdown for any user trying to use an authenticated MCP server, which is a common enterprise pattern.
aliases: MCP authentication headers missing in pre-flight check
MCP server auth headers not forwarded to HEAD request
signals.review_reason: This is a P0-level user pain point: it completely blocks the entire class of authenticated MCP servers. The MCP pre-flight HEAD request omits auth headers, causing HTTP 500 from the server and silent skip. Users are given no actionable error and must manually patch mcp_tools.py. Two independent external users reported the same bug, confirming it affects real users in production (e.g. litellm-mcp with API key auth). The user impact is severe and well-evidenced.

source_issues.title: MCP pre-flight HEAD request missing authentication headers
source_issues.evidence: Bug with reproduction steps. Impact stated: 'All authenticated MCP servers (requiring API keys/tokens) fail pre-flight and are silently skipped.' Root cause identified at mcp_tools.py line 861: client.head(url) without passing server_config headers. Python repro script included.

source_issues.title: MCP pre-flight HEAD request missing authentication headers
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate bug report. Includes full environment (deepagents-cli 0.0.50, SDK 0.5.6), setup config for litellm-mcp with x-litellm-api-key header, exact reproduction steps, and expected vs actual behavior. Impact: 'All authenticated MCP servers (requiring API keys or tokens) fail pre-flight. Servers are silently skipped with misleading HTTP 500 error. Users cannot use authenticated MCP servers with DeepAgents CLI.'

signals.topic: SubAgent response_format breaks intermediate tool calls and human-in-the-loop (HITL) flows by forcing structured-output binding on every subagent model call
signals.summary: When a SubAgent has response_format configured, DeepAgents forwards it to the underlying model on every model call inside the subagent (not just the final response). This causes provider-native structured-output constraints to be applied to intermediate tool-call arguments, resulting in malformed or empty arguments for tools like ask_human. The same subagent with identical prompts and tools produces correct intermediate payloads without response_format, but broken payloads with it. This makes SubAgent.response_format fundamentally incompatible with any subagent that uses intermediate tools or HITL before returning a final result.
aliases: SubAgent response_format corrupts intermediate tool arguments
SubAgent structured output breaks HITL tool calls
signals.review_reason: This is a P1-level user pain point: the response_format feature fundamentally breaks any SubAgent that relies on intermediate tool calls or HITL workflows (e.g. approval/ask_human patterns). Two independent external users reproduced the same issue with concrete evidence: the same subagent code produces correct ask_human structured_data without response_format but null/malformed data with it. The bug is architectural — provider structured-output binding is applied per-call instead of only at the final subagent response — making response_format unusable for any subagent with tools, which severely undermines the feature's value.

source_issues.title: SubAgent response_format affects intermediate tool/HITL calls
source_issues.evidence: Bug with complete Python reproduction script. Shows that with response_format: ask_human structured_data becomes {"summary": null, "selections": [{"options": [{}, {}]}]} instead of correct nested structure. Root cause: _get_bound_model() binds the model with provider structured-output kwargs on every model call, not only at terminal subagent response. This is a direct regression: same subagent with same prompt produces correct output without response_format.

source_issues.title: SubAgent response_format affects intermediate tool/HITL calls
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate with additional error mode: tool schema validation can fail before tool is ever called because response_format causes tool schema to be submitted to provider in structured-output mode. Also shows LangChain attempting to parse intermediate message as response_format after tool loop recovery failure.

signals.topic: Reasoning content dropped from stream_events v3 when message contains tool_call
signals.summary: Silent data corruption — reasoning text visible during streaming but permanently lost from persisted AIMessage.content when same message contains a tool_call block
aliases: stream_events v3 reasoning loss with tool calls
reasoning block dropped from AIMessage content
signals.review_reason: Silent data corruption — reasoning text is visible during streaming but permanently lost from the persisted message. Breaks conversation history replay and debugging for production agent deployments using Gemini with thinking enabled. Two independent reports confirm the issue.

source_issues.title: stream_events(version="v3"): reasoning content dropped from AIMessage when message also contains a tool_call
source_issues.evidence: Silent data loss — reasoning streamed via .reasoning projection but dropped from persisted AIMessage.content when same message contains a tool_call block. Affects Gemini agents with thinking enabled.

source_issues.title: stream_events(version="v3"): reasoning content dropped from AIMessage when same message contains a tool_call
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate report of same issue. Root cause in _finish() method — no sweep for unfinished reasoning blocks like there is for tool_call_chunks.

signals.topic: ChatDeepSeek drops reasoning_content on outbound requests breaking multi-turn tool-using flows
signals.summary: DeepSeek reasoner models require prior-turn reasoning_content echoed back, but the outbound path drops it causing HTTP 400 errors from DeepSeek API
signals.review_reason: API-level failure causing multi-turn conversations with DeepSeek reasoner models to completely break with HTTP 400. Users cannot build persistent agent workflows with these models. Two reports confirm root cause is in the message serialization path.

source_issues.title: ChatDeepSeek drops reasoning_content on outbound requests, breaking multi-turn / tool-using flows with reasoner models
source_issues.evidence: DeepSeek reasoner models require prior turn reasoning_content echoed back. Outbound path drops it via _convert_message_to_dict, causing HTTP 400 from DeepSeek API.

source_issues.title: ChatDeepSeek drops reasoning_content on outbound requests, breaking multi-turn / tool-using flows with reasoner models
source_issues.evidence: Closed duplicate. Root cause: _create_chat_result captures reasoning_content but _get_request_payload serializes it away.

signals.topic: ChatOpenAI with Gemini models fails on multi-turn conversations due to missing thought signatures causing 400 BadRequestError
signals.summary: ChatOpenAI fails to provide thought signatures in multi-turn conversations when used with Gemini models, resulting in HTTP 400 BadRequestError
signals.review_reason: Main flow blocking — multi-turn agent conversations with Gemini models completely fail with HTTP 400 due to missing thought signatures. This prevents any persistent conversation workflow with Gemini models through ChatOpenAI.

source_issues.title: ChatOpenAI fails to provide thought signatures on multi-turn conversations when used with Gemini models, resulting in 400 BadRequestError
source_issues.evidence: Multi-turn conversations with Gemini models produce HTTP 400 BadRequestError due to missing thought signatures. Main flow is completely blocked for Gemini model users in multi-turn scenarios.

signals.topic: Structured output streaming drops x-request-id response headers breaking request observability
signals.summary: ChatOpenAI.with_structured_output with streaming mode drops response headers including x-request-id, breaking observability and request correlation
signals.review_reason: Critical observability path broken — users cannot correlate streamed requests with provider-side logs for debugging and incident investigation when using structured output with streaming. Only manifests with the specific combination of structured_output + streaming mode.

source_issues.title: ChatOpenAI.with_structured_output(..., method="json_schema").stream() drops response headers / x-request-id in response_metadata
source_issues.evidence: HeaderCaptureHandler demonstrates x-request-id missing only with structured_output+streaming combination. Works with plain streaming and AzureChatOpenAI. Breaks request correlation for debugging.

signals.topic: HTMLSemanticPreservingSplitter generates invalid output and preserves unsafe links
signals.summary: HTMLSemanticPreservingSplitter processes malformed hrefs and javascript: pseudo-links, generating invalid markdown and security risks
signals.review_reason: Generates invalid output and preserves security risks (javascript: links) in processed content. Users ingesting this output into downstream systems may encounter broken links or security vulnerabilities.

source_issues.title: HTMLSemanticPreservingSplitter processes malformed and unsafe links
source_issues.evidence: Empty href values and javascript: pseudo-links are processed, generating invalid markdown and preserving unsafe links in output.

signals.topic: Long-running tool calls silently re-executed by Cloud checkpoint sweep, causing 2-3x redundant work and cost
signals.summary: On LangGraph Cloud, tool calls taking >3 minutes are silently re-dispatched from checkpoint while the original is still running. Both complete successfully, resulting in massive redundant API costs.
signals.review_reason: This is a direct cost impact issue: users are silently billed 2-3x for every long tool call on LangGraph Cloud. The re-execution is invisible to users — no error, no warning — but doubles or triples their LLM API spend. Multiple attempted workarounds all failed, indicating no user-level mitigation exists. This blocks production use for any workflow with tool calls >3 minutes.

source_issues.title: Long tool calls (~180s+) silently re-executed from checkpoint on LangGraph Cloud
source_issues.evidence: Tool calls taking >3 minutes get silently re-dispatched from last checkpoint while original still runs. Both complete successfully with identical arguments (same content hash). Consistent across langgraph 1.1.3-1.1.6, EU Cloud, Plus tier. No user-configurable workaround found (BG_JOB_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD_SECS and BG_JOB_ISOLATED_LOOPS have no effect). Root cause: BG_JOB_HEARTBEAT=120s hardcoded, sweep runs every 240s and calls Runs.Sweep() marking runs as stale.

signals.topic: invoke(version='v2') returns inconsistent polymorphic types — GraphOutput vs list[StreamPart] depending on stream_mode
signals.summary: invoke(v2) returns GraphOutput when stream_mode='values' but list[StreamPart] for other stream modes, breaking type-safe downstream code without documentation.
signals.review_reason: This breaks type-safe code in production: downstream applications that rely on consistent return types from invoke(version='v2') will get runtime errors or incorrect behavior when using non-values stream modes. The inconsistency is not documented, so users discover it through runtime failures. It affects the new v2 API which users are expected to adopt.

source_issues.title: invoke(version='v2') returns list[StreamPart] instead of GraphOutput when stream_mode != 'values' — polymorphic return type undocumented
source_issues.evidence: Reproducer shows stream_mode='values' returns GraphOutput with .value and .interrupts, while stream_mode='updates' returns raw list[StreamPart]. Both patterns (canonical subgraph and manual wrapper) exhibit the same inconsistency. No documentation exists for the polymorphic behavior. Breaks type-annotated downstream code expecting consistent return types.

signals.topic: langgraph-runtime-inmem: subgraph stream events silently dropped when stream_mode query param is supplied on joinStream endpoint
signals.summary: GET /threads/{id}/runs/{id}/stream drops all subgraph events when client supplies a stream_mode param, due to exact-match filter not matching namespace-prefixed mode strings.
signals.review_reason: Subgraph stream events are silently lost when a stream_mode query param is passed to the joinStream endpoint. Users monitoring or processing subgraph events via the SDK will receive incomplete data with no indication of dropped events. This is a regression (marked as joinStream regression) affecting a non-trivial feature: multi-agent/subgraph streaming.

source_issues.title: langgraph-runtime-inmem: Runs.Stream.join drops subgraph events when stream_mode is supplied (joinStream regression)
source_issues.evidence: langgraph_api.stream.consume publishes subgraph events with mode strings of form '<base>|<ns1>|<ns2>' (e.g. 'updates|subgraph:abc'). Runs.Stream.join filters via exact equality, so mode='updates|subgraph:abc' with stream_mode=['updates','tasks'] produces False for both conditions and silently drops the event. Affects both resumable replay and live tail. Reproducer confirms this is a regression in joinStream behavior.

signals.topic: interrupt() inside while loop causes extra unwanted resume executions on resume
signals.summary: When interrupt() is used inside a while loop for input validation, resuming with valid input causes unexpected extra loop iterations instead of cleanly exiting.
signals.review_reason: interrupt() inside a while loop for user input validation is a fundamental human-in-the-loop pattern (the most common way to build forms with validation). Users implementing this canonical pattern encounter extra/unexpected resume executions, making the interrupt mechanism unreliable for real user-input workflows. This blocks the primary use case of interrupt(): getting and validating human input.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Interrupt() in a loop will cause extra resumes
source_issues.evidence: User implements a typical input-validation pattern: while True loop with interrupt() to prompt for age, validating input on resume, and returning if valid. Expected: one resume exits the loop. Actual: extra resumes cause unexpected behavior. This is a common human-in-the-loop pattern for form validation, making the bug a blocker for valid user-input scenarios.

signals.topic: RuntimeError error message contains broken HTTP 404 docs URL, preventing user self-resolution
signals.summary: When resuming with multiple pending interrupts, the RuntimeError embeds a docs URL that returns 404, blocking users from self-diagnosing and fixing the issue.
aliases: 404 URL in error message multiple interrupts
signals.review_reason: A RuntimeError message contains a dead URL, preventing users from self-resolving a non-trivial error condition. While the error itself is informational, a broken link in an error message is a quality defect that forces users to seek help externally. The fix is a one-line URL update but the impact is on every user who hits this error condition.

source_issues.title: docs(langgraph): broken docs URL in RuntimeError raised on resume with multiple pending interrupts
source_issues.evidence: RuntimeError for multiple pending interrupts embeds URL https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/add-human-in-the-loop#resume-multiple-interrupts-with-one-invocation which returns HTTP 404. The actual documentation lives at a different URL. Users hitting this error (a non-obvious scenario) cannot self-resolve and must open an issue or search elsewhere. Source located at libs/langgraph/langgraph/pregel/_loop.py:771.

signals.topic: Iteration node returns None result and crashes with 'Working outside of application context' when parallel mode is enabled (v1.14.1)
signals.summary: In Dify v1.14.1, enabling parallel mode on an Iteration node causes it to either return a [null] result without executing any logic, or crash with 'Working outside of application context' error. This breaks workflow execution for any workflow using iteration with parallel mode — a combination introduced or affected in v1.14.1. Two independent reporters (#36158, #36132) confirmed this regression.
aliases: Iteration node broken with parallel mode
signals.review_reason: v1.14.1 中的回归问题：Iteration 节点在开启 parallel mode 时完全失效（返回 null 或抛出 application context 错误），导致工作流无法执行。两个独立 issue 确认，影响主流程。count=2 且高置信度，标记 P0。

source_issues.title: Iteration Node Returns Nonetype Result when switching on Parallel Mode
source_issues.evidence: Iteration node returns [null] and executes nothing when parallel mode is toggled on in v1.14.1. Node output is None.

source_issues.title: Iteration block fails with 'Working outside of application context error' when parallel mode is enabled in Dify 1.14.1
source_issues.evidence: Iteration block crashes with 'Working outside of application context' error when parallel mode is enabled. Confirms same root cause as #36158. Multiple reporters confirm v1.14.1 regression.

signals.topic: Docker API build fails due to dev-only dify-agent path resolution in production builds
signals.summary: When building the API Docker image with a checkout that includes PR #36087, the Docker build fails because it tries to resolve the local `dify-agent` path dependency outside the Docker build context, resulting in 'Distribution not found' error. This blocks users from building the Docker image for deployment.
signals.review_reason: 用户无法成功构建生产环境的 Docker 镜像，属于主流程阻断问题。具体错误信息明确（distribution not found），regression 来自 #36087，有明确复现步骤。

source_issues.title: API Docker build fails when resolving dev-only dify-agent path
source_issues.evidence: Docker build fails with 'error: Failed to generate package metadata for dify-agent==0.1.0 @ directory+../dify-agent. Caused by: Distribution not found at: file:///app/dify-agent'. Blocks production Docker builds.

signals.topic: LLM node cannot access retrieved knowledge attachments for web app end users — returns 'Invalid upload file'
signals.summary: When a web app end user invokes a published chat app with a Knowledge Retrieval node, and the retrieved segment contains an attachment (e.g., image), the downstream LLM node fails with 'Invalid upload file'. The attachment is rejected by upload file ownership checks because the app invocation runs as an end user, while the knowledge-base attachment is owned by the workspace tenant. This breaks a core multimodal RAG workflow.
signals.review_reason: 多模态 RAG 工作流的核心功能失效——LLM 节点无法访问知识库检索返回的附件文件，导致工作流运行失败。虽然只影响 web app 端用户场景，但属于关键功能不可用，且有明确错误日志和根因分析。

source_issues.title: LLM node cannot access retrieved knowledge attachments for web app end users
source_issues.evidence: LLM node fails with RuntimeError: Invalid upload file when consuming multimodal attachments from knowledge retrieval. Workflow run fails. Core multimodal RAG pipeline broken for web app end users.

signals.topic: Sandbox crashes with panic: 'could not create filter' causing workflow nodes to fail
signals.summary: When executing workflows, the sandbox process crashes with a panic ('could not create filter') in the seccomp filter setup, causing the workflow node to fail. This blocks workflow execution for any user relying on sandbox-isolated code execution.
aliases: Sandbox process crashes on workflow execution
signals.review_reason: Sandbox 进程崩溃（panic: could not create filter）导致工作流节点执行失败，是主流程阻断问题。错误发生在 seccomp 过滤器创建阶段，影响所有依赖沙箱隔离执行的工作流用户。

source_issues.title: sandbox bug
source_issues.evidence: Sandbox crashes with 'panic: could not create filter' in main.DifySeccomp, workflow node fails with '流程中有 1 个节点运行异常'. Blocks any workflow using sandbox-isolated execution.

signals.topic: First message in conversation with empty knowledge retrieval returns 422 'Request param content len should not be 0', breaking chat initiation
signals.summary: On the first message of a brand-new conversation in a Chat App or Agent Chat App with a Knowledge Base, if the query does not match any content in the knowledge base (empty retrieval), the downstream model API returns HTTP 422 with 'Request param content len should not be 0'. This causes the entire stream to fail with a PluginInvokeError. The conversation cannot proceed from the first message.
aliases: Conversation fails when knowledge base returns no results on first turn
signals.review_reason: 会话首条消息因知识库检索为空导致 422 错误，会话无法启动，属于主流程阻断。错误机制清晰：空检索结果导致消息内容为空，触发模型 API 的 content length 校验。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Empty message content causes 422 error (Request param content len should not be 0) when knowledge retrieval returns no results on first message
source_issues.evidence: 422 error 'Request param content len should not be 0' from model API on first message when knowledge retrieval returns empty. Stream fails with PluginInvokeError. Conversation cannot start.

signals.topic: POST /configure 端点缺少角色授权检查，导致任意 API Key 持有者可重定向全局 LLM 配置并窃取用户数据
signals.summary: POST /configure 端点仅验证认证令牌有效性，从未检查用户角色。任何持有分布式 API Key 的服务/团队成员均可将全局 LLM 和 embedder 流量重定向至攻击者控制的服务器，造成用户 prompt、记忆内容和嵌入向量的大规模窃取，且该配置变更持久化到数据库，影响所有用户。
aliases: Global LLM config hijack via API key
Missing role check on admin endpoint
signals.review_reason: 严重授权缺陷：任何持有 API Key 的非管理员用户均可修改全局 LLM 配置，将流量重定向至攻击者控制的服务器。PoC 明确证明用户数据（prompt、记忆、嵌入向量）被窃取，且配置变更持久化至数据库，影响所有用户和服务。此为典型的主流程阻断型安全漏洞，直接导致数据泄露，符合 P0 定义（高影响主流程阻断+强用户影响证据）。

source_issues.title: Missing Authorization on POST /configure Allows Any API Key Holder to Hijack Global LLM Configuration
source_issues.evidence: 完整的 PoC 证明任意 API Key 可将全局 LLM/embedder URL 重定向至攻击者控制端点，后续所有 memory.add() / memory.search() 请求的用户数据（prompt、记忆内容、嵌入向量）均被窃取。PoC 包含 6/6 测试通过截图，明确指出 server/main.py:313-318、server/auth.py:145-171 受影响，config 持久化至 PostgreSQL。

signals.topic: @mem0/openclaw-mem0 发布包缺少编译产物，导致 OpenClaw 网关无法启动
signals.summary: npm 发布包仅含 TypeScript 源码（index.ts），无 dist/ 目录、无 main/module 字段。OpenClaw 新版本强制要求插件提供编译后的 ./dist/index.{js,mjs,cjs}，导致安装 openclaw-mem0 后网关完全无法启动，且 openclaw doctor --fix 无法自动修复，用户必须手动执行 tsdown 打包。
aliases: Gateway fails to start due to missing dist files
signals.review_reason: 打包发布缺陷导致关键集成功能完全不可用：安装 openclaw-mem0 后 OpenClaw 网关彻底无法启动，无自动修复方案，用户需具备 TypeScript 打包知识手动 workaround。非阻断所有用户但严重损害该插件用户的体验，属于关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: @mem0/openclaw-mem0: published package ships unbuilt TypeScript; bricks OpenClaw gateway after recent plugin-validation tightening
source_issues.evidence: 安装 @mem0/openclaw-mem0@0.1.2 后，网关启动失败并报错：'plugin requires compiled runtime output for TypeScript entry index.ts: expected ./dist/index.js'。workaround 要求用户手动 npx tsdown 打包，每次重装后需重复操作，无用户自行修复能力。

signals.topic: addMemory 流程未将 metadata（如 app_id）纳入向量检索和消息分区过滤，导致多应用场景下的跨上下文污染
signals.summary: Phase 1 现有记忆检索仅按 user_id/agent_id/run_id 过滤，metadata 中的 app_id 被排除在外。SQLite 消息分区同样未包含 app_id，导致同一 user_id 在不同 app_id 下的记忆和消息窗口互相污染。Memory.search 则正确支持完整 filters，两者行为不一致。
aliases: Metadata/app_id not included in addMemory retrieval filters
signals.review_reason: 功能缺陷造成多应用部署下的记忆跨上下文污染：用户在不同 app_id 下的记忆和消息窗口互相干扰，导致检索结果包含不应出现在当前应用上下文的记忆内容，直接损害记忆系统的准确性，属于主流程功能错误。

source_issues.title: `addMemory` flow excludes `metadata` (e.g. `app_id`) from retrieval and message partitioning, causing cross-context contamination in multi-app setups
source_issues.evidence: Issue 提供复现代码，证明同一 user_id 在不同 app_id 下调用 add() 时，Phase 1 检索返回其他 app_id 的记忆，消息窗口也被共享。Memory.search 使用完整 filters 但 addMemory 不一致，造成多应用部署时记忆互相污染。

signals.topic: v3 ADD-only 提取管道不发出 UPDATE/DELETE 事件，导致时间敏感属性产生陈旧/矛盾记忆
signals.summary: v3 提取管道为纯 ADD 模式，不再生成 UPDATE/DELETE 事件。用户更新可变事实（如雇主、城市）时，旧记忆不被覆盖或删除，新旧记忆共存，检索时语义+BM25+实体匹配无法区分新旧，导致返回过时信息。
aliases: ADD-only extraction produces stale contradicting memories
No UPDATE/DELETE events in v3 extraction pipeline
Stale facts accumulate for mutable attributes
signals.review_reason: 核心记忆准确性缺陷：v3 提取管道对可变事实产生矛盾记忆积累，用户检索时收到过时信息。在需要准确个人数据的场景（HR 助手、医疗记录等）下此问题直接导致错误决策或响应，属于主流程体验显著下降。

source_issues.title: ADD-only extraction in v3 may surface stale/contradictory facts for time-sensitive attributes
source_issues.evidence: Issue 描述具体场景：用户 3 个月前说'在 A 公司工作'，今天说'跳槽到 B 公司'，两条记忆均被存储，检索'用户在哪工作'时 A 公司因评分信号未纳入时间权重而可能排在前列，导致记忆系统返回错误信息。

signals.topic: BM25 关键词搜索和实体提取硬编码依赖英语 spaCy 模型，导致非英语用户混合搜索降级为纯语义搜索且无错误提示
signals.summary: v3 混合搜索管道的 BM25 和实体增强路径硬编码加载 en_core_web_sm，对 CJK/阿拉伯语/泰语等脚本无法正确分词。非英语用户使用非英语查询时 BM25 信号静默降级为 no-op，实体增强也消失，检索精度显著下降，但系统不报任何错误。
aliases: BM25 hardcoded to English spaCy model
signals.review_reason: 关键搜索功能对非英语用户实质不可用：BM25 和实体增强静默降级为无操作，用户未收到任何错误提示，导致精确关键词匹配和实体 boost 功能完全失效，直接损害全球非英语用户的检索体验，属于关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: BM25 keyword search and entity extraction are hardcoded to English
source_issues.evidence: Issue 明确指出 mem0/utils/spacy_models.py 两处硬编码 en_core_web_sm，非英语查询的 lemma 无法与存储的 lemma 匹配，导致 bm25_scores 为空、has_bm25=False、实体 boost 消失。对于全球大多数非英语用户，v3 混合搜索静默降级为纯语义搜索，精度关键功能实质不可用。

signals.topic: .NET A2A streaming handler emits spec-violating empty Parts arrays and duplicate messageId across SSE events, making streaming unusable
signals.summary: HandleNewMessageStreamingAsync emits one A2A Message per OpenAI chunk. Bookend chunks (role-only first delta, finish-reason last delta) produce empty Parts=[], violating A2A REQUIRED field constraint. Additionally, all chunks in a single completion share the same chatcmpl-... ResponseId as messageId, causing A2A clients to collapse the entire stream to one message (typically the empty bookend). Result: spec-compliant clients reject events with pydantic validation error, or show an empty agent reply. Workaround requires disabling streaming on the agent card, losing streaming UX entirely.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow streaming endpoint is fully broken. Spec-compliant A2A clients cannot consume the SSE stream at all. Only workaround is to disable the streaming capability, losing the feature entirely. Clear blocking impact on the core A2A streaming use case.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Bug]: A2A streaming handler emits one Message per chat-client update with shared messageId and empty Parts on bookend chunks
source_issues.evidence: Python a2a-sdk pydantic model enforces min_items=1 on Parts and rejects every SSE event with 'Message object must have a non-empty parts array'. A2A clients that use messageId for dedup collapse all chunks to one (the empty bookend), showing empty reply in UI. Workaround disables streaming entirely.

signals.topic: Python AG-UI history replay sends invalid assistant/tool message sequences to OpenAI, causing hard 400 API errors and making conversation threads unusable
signals.summary: When agent_framework.ag_ui replays persisted thread history, outbound model payloads can contain unmatched tool_calls (assistant message with tool_calls but no matching tool result messages), reordered tool messages, or duplicated entries. This violates the OpenAI message contract, producing HTTP 400 errors: 'An assistant message with tool_calls must be followed by tool messages responding to each tool_call_id'. The conversation thread becomes unusable after the first such failure.
aliases: AG-UI session history payload validation failure
signals.review_reason: Produces hard HTTP 400 failures from the OpenAI API provider, making persisted conversation threads unusable. Labeled 'reproduced' by maintainers. Not P0 only because failures are described as intermittent rather than deterministic.

source_issues.title: Python: [Bug]: AG-UI history replay can send invalid assistant/tool sequence to OpenAI (tool_calls without matching tool messages)
source_issues.evidence: Issue is labeled 'reproduced'. Hard 400 failures from OpenAI/Azure when replaying history: 'An assistant message with tool_calls must be followed by tool messages responding to each tool_call_id'. Results in unusable conversation threads. Matches same root cause pattern as .NET issue #5839 (empty content added to messages).

signals.topic: Python MCPStreamableHTTPTool unconditionally re-injects Authorization headers on cross-origin HTTP redirects, causing credential leakage to third-party domains
signals.summary: The _inject_headers event hook in MCPStreamableHTTPTool re-applies bearer tokens from _mcp_call_headers on every outbound httpx request without origin checking. httpx strips Authorization headers on cross-origin redirects via _redirect_headers, but the hook re-injects them on the redirect hop. This leaks bearer tokens to attacker-controlled domains. The bug is latent today because _mcp_call_headers does not propagate to the MCP SDK post_writer task (per issue #4808), but becomes reachable when mcp-sdk#2298 (merged 2026-03-31) ships in a PyPI release. Reporter has a working reproduction harness and is willing to route through MSRC.
signals.review_reason: Security-relevant credential leak with working proof-of-concept. Although latent today (blocked by #4808), the upstream fix that unblocks it is already merged and awaiting PyPI release. Waiting to patch after it ships means a window of active exploitation. Bearer token leakage to third-party domains on redirect is a clear user impact (financial and data security). Reporter explicitly offers MSRC routing.

source_issues.title: Python: [Bug]: MCPStreamableHTTPTool re-injects header_provider headers on cross-origin redirects (latent until #4808 / mcp-sdk#2298 ship)
source_issues.evidence: Reporter has a working proof-of-concept (docker-free three-process harness) demonstrating bearer token leakage to attacker-controlled domain on cross-origin redirect. Same class as CVE-2018-1000007 (curl), CVE-2024-37891 (urllib3), CVE-2023-32681 (requests). Reporter offers to route through MSRC. Reporter explicitly requests patching before the upstream mcp-sdk fix ships to PyPI.

signals.topic: .NET AG-UI streams responses from all registered agents simultaneously when multiple agents are configured, with no built-in way to restrict streaming to a single agent
signals.summary: When a .NET backend registers multiple agents (e.g., PlannerAgent + ExecutorAgent) via AgentWorkflowBuilder, the AG-UI package SSE stream emits responses from all agents as they execute, not just the final output agent. Users have no built-in option to restrict streaming to only the desired agent. The reporter had to implement a custom AgentOrchestrator class with manual workflow coordination and non-streaming planner execution as a workaround, which is significant custom code outside the intended framework usage pattern.
signals.review_reason: Significant UX degradation for multi-agent workflows: all intermediate agent outputs are streamed, not just the final result. No framework-level option to control this. User was forced to write substantial custom orchestration code to work around the lack of a built-in solution. Low count (1) and single-repo limits to P2.

source_issues.title: .NET: [Feature]: Unable to restrict AG-UI streaming to a single agent
source_issues.evidence: Multi-agent workflow streaming from all agents simultaneously, not just the final agent. No built-in framework option to restrict. Reporter wrote a full custom AgentOrchestrator class (~80 lines of custom code) as workaround, implementing non-streaming planner execution + streaming-only executor. Significant deviation from intended declarative workflow usage.

signals.topic: GroupChat round-robin speaker selection off-by-one bug when max_round is even
signals.summary: GroupChat's round-robin scheduling algorithm has an off-by-one error that causes the last agent to be silently skipped when max_round is set to an even number, leading to incomplete multi-agent conversations.
aliases: GroupChat round robin last agent skipped
signals.review_reason: 3条来自同一用户的issue均描述GroupChat轮询调度算法在max_round为偶数时最后一个agent永远不会被选中的可复现bug。用户明确标注了autogen-agentchat 0.4.x和Python 3.11环境，并提供了复现步骤。这是主流程阻断性问题——GroupChat是多agent协作的核心组件，调度算法出错直接导致部分agent永远无法发言，任务结果不完整。count=3达到高频阈值，有明确复现步骤，属于P0场景。

source_issues.title: GroupChat round-robin skips agent when max_round is even
source_issues.evidence: With 3 agents and max_round=4, agent C never speaks. Reproducible: 1) Create GroupChat with agents A, B, C. 2) Set max_round=4. 3) Observe agent C is never selected.

source_issues.title: GroupChat round-robin skips agent when max_round is even
source_issues.evidence: With 3 agents and max_round=4, agent C never speaks. Reproducible with autogen-agentchat 0.4.x on Python 3.11.

source_issues.title: GroupChat round-robin skips agent when max_round is even
source_issues.evidence: With 3 agents and max_round=4, agent C never speaks due to off-by-one error in speaker selection loop.

signals.topic: AutoGen Studio unauthenticated RCE via WebSocket team_config
signals.summary: AutoGen Studio's WebSocket endpoint accepts attacker-controlled Python code through team_config with default no-auth configuration, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution (CVSS 9.8).
signals.review_reason: CVSS 9.8级别的未认证RCE漏洞：WebSocket端点接收未校验的team_config，其中FunctionTool._from_config()直接执行attacker-controlled Python代码。默认配置auth type='none'，攻击者可在无需任何凭证和用户交互的情况下完全控制服务器。这是关键安全漏洞，虽然只有1条issue但影响极其严重（完整服务器入侵），review_reason明确给出强证据支撑P0定级。

source_issues.title: [Security] Critical: Unauthenticated RCE via WebSocket team_config (CVSS 9.8)
source_issues.evidence: FunctionTool._from_config() calls exec(source_code) with attacker-controlled Python code via WebSocket. Default AuthConfig sets type='none'. CVSS 9.8: AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H. Complete server compromise, no authentication required, no user interaction needed.

signals.topic: OpenAIChatCompletionClient缺少http_client序列化配置项，企业代理场景主流程阻断
signals.summary: 通过序列化配置加载模型客户端时无法传入自定义http_client，企业内网通过代理访问模型时被拒绝，主流程完全阻断。
signals.review_reason: 用户报告通过序列化配置(yaml/json)加载OpenAIChatCompletionClient时无法传入自定义http_client，企业内网代理场景下模型访问被endpoint拒绝，主流程完全阻断。这是明确的生产环境使用阻断，虽只有1条issue但影响场景具体（企业Azure代理），影响程度高（主流程fail），P1合理。

source_issues.title: Add http client property in serialized config
source_issues.evidence: 使用公司自定义模型时，不传http_client参数则endpoint拒绝访问。用户通过yaml/json序列化配置加载OpenAIChatCompletionClient，无法传入自定义httpx.AsyncClient，导致企业代理场景下主流程完全阻断。

signals.topic: Gemini模型使用工具调用时抛出openai.BadRequestError
signals.summary: 在autogen-agentchat 0.4.1配合Gemini 1.5 Pro进行工具调用时触发BadRequestError，功能不可用。
signals.review_reason: 用户在autogen-agentchat 0.4.1 + Gemini 1.5 Pro场景下执行工具调用时触发BadRequestError，功能不可用。issue已closed但未提供解决方案，暗示可能是用户配置问题或框架兼容性问题。工具调用是autogen核心功能，该场景失败构成功能不可用场景，P1。

source_issues.title: openai.BadRequestError when using Gemini models for tool calls
source_issues.evidence: autogen-agentchat 0.4.1 + google-generativeai 0.8.0 + Gemini 1.5 Pro，执行工具调用时抛出BadRequestError。issue已closed但无修复说明。

signals.topic: UI mode 1.60 fails to execute any tests, all tests show as failed with no error logs
signals.summary: In Playwright 1.60, UI mode fails to execute any tests — every test immediately shows a failed result without any error message or log, making UI mode completely unusable.
aliases: UI mode test execution broken in 1.60
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：UI mode是Playwright的核心调试界面，1.60版本中完全无法执行测试，所有测试均显示失败且无任何错误日志，导致用户无法使用UI mode进行任何测试调试。降级到1.59可复现修复。此问题为版本退化bug，严重性极高。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: UI mode does not execute any tests on 1.60
source_issues.evidence: All tests show 'Failed' result with no error returned. Downgrading to 1.59 fixes the problem. Issue confirmed reproducible on 1.60 only.

signals.topic: page.pause() debug window not appearing on Windows, blocking interactive debugging
signals.summary: On Windows, page.pause() causes the test to pause but the debug window does not appear, preventing users from clicking continue or inspecting page objects.
aliases: page.pause debug UI not visible Windows
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：page.pause()的debug window是Playwright交互式调试的核心功能，在Windows上完全不显示，用户无法点击continue或检查页面对象，导致交互式调试工作流完全失效。这是一个退化bug（之前版本正常）。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: page.pause does not display debug window in windows
source_issues.evidence: Test pauses but debug window does not appear on Windows 11. User cannot click continue or inspect objects. Previously worked before upgrade.

signals.topic: global setup exceptions silently swallowed in UI mode, showing 'No tests' instead of error
signals.summary: When globalSetup throws an exception, UI mode silently swallows it and displays 'No tests' without any error indication, misleading users.
aliases: globalSetup error not shown UI mode
UI mode swallows global setup exceptions
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断/误导：globalSetup异常在UI mode中被完全吞没，用户看到误导性的'No tests'消息而非真实错误。这导致用户在错误的上下文中排查问题，浪费大量时间。CLI模式正常报错，但UI mode完全隐藏了错误信息。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: global setup exceptions are swallowed in UI mode
source_issues.evidence: globalSetup exception is completely hidden in UI mode. User sees 'No tests' message instead of the actual error. CLI mode correctly reports the exception.

signals.topic: connectOverCDP fails when HTTP proxy environment variables are set, blocking CDP debugging
signals.summary: chromium.connectOverCDP() fails with 502 error when HTTP_PROXY is set, because Playwright sets the Host header to the proxy address instead of the target DevTools endpoint.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：connectOverCDP()是连接已有Chrome实例进行CDP调试的核心API，在设置HTTP_PROXY环境变量后完全失败（502），导致用户无法在代理环境下使用CDP调试。这是一个功能性bug，根本原因明确。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: connectOverCDP() sets proxy Host header when discovering CDP websocket URL
source_issues.evidence: connectOverCDP fails with 502 when HTTP_PROXY is set. The Host header is incorrectly set to proxy address instead of target DevTools authority. Root cause identified in Node.js http.request() behavior.

signals.topic: WebKit on macOS returns incorrect event.timeStamp (Cocoa reference date instead of DOMHighResTimeStamp)
signals.summary: On macOS WebKit, Playwright-synthesized events return event.timeStamp as ~800 billion ms (Cocoa/CFAbsoluteTime epoch 2001-01-01) instead of a small DOMHighResTimeStamp near performance.now().
aliases: WebKit event timestamp Cocoa reference date
signals.review_reason: 关键功能数据错误：event.timeStamp被错误地设置为Cocoa参考日期而非DOMHighResTimeStamp，这是静默失败（数值看起来正常但来自错误的时间起点）。任何依赖event.timeStamp进行时间差计算的代码都会产生完全错误的结果，影响WebKit测试中所有交互事件的计时验证。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: WebKit on macOS sets event.timeStamp to a value that looks like a Cocoa reference date
source_issues.evidence: event.timeStamp returns ~800 billion ms on macOS WebKit (Cocoa epoch from 2001-01-01). Chromium and Firefox return correct values. Only Playwright-synthesized trusted events affected. Affects all input API events: click, pointerdown, etc.

signals.topic: .NET: JSON serializer options mismatch causes enum parameters to fail during tool invocation
signals.summary: KernelJsonSchemaBuilder generates tool schemas with JsonStringEnumConverter, but KernelFunctionFromMethod.TryToDeserializeValue uses default JSON options without it, causing any function with enum parameters to fail with ArgumentException or JsonException at runtime.
signals.review_reason: This is a confirmed runtime failure in the primary tool-calling flow. Any user defining a kernel function with enum parameters (including nested enums in arrays/objects) experiences an unhandled exception during invocation. The bug is acknowledged by a TODO comment in the codebase itself. Severity is P0 because the main function invocation path is broken.

source_issues.title: .Net: Bug: JSON serializer options don't match between tool schema and tool calls, causing enum parameters to fail.
source_issues.evidence: Full stack traces provided: System.ArgumentException when SK brute-forces JSON string into enum parameter, and System.Text.Json.JsonException when enum value cannot be converted. Both exceptions clearly demonstrate runtime failure of kernel function invocations with enum parameters.

signals.topic: .NET: KernelJsonSchema generates invalid schema with duplicate 'null' for nullable enum parameters defaulted to null, causing OpenAI strict-mode tool calls to fail
signals.summary: When a method parameter is a nullable enum with a default value of null, KernelJsonSchema produces type=['string','null','null'] and enum with duplicate null entries, which fails OpenAI strict-mode schema validation with HTTP 400 invalid_function_parameters.
signals.review_reason: This causes OpenAI strict-mode tool calls to fail with a 400 error, blocking the primary use case of function calling. While a workaround exists (removing default null), it is non-obvious and the schema bug is a clear internal inconsistency (duplicate 'null'). Ranked P1 instead of P0 because the failure is specific to strict mode and the workaround is documented.

source_issues.title: .Net: Bug: Possible problem with KernelJsonSchema generation
source_issues.evidence: Produces explicit HTTP 400 (invalid_request_error: invalid_function_parameters) from OpenAI API when using strict mode. Schema output shows type:['string','null','null'] which is invalid JSON Schema. Workaround (removing default null) is non-obvious.

signals.topic: .NET: Assembly version conflicts on Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces cause build warnings and runtime FileLoadException for .NET Framework projects using InMemory/SqliteVec connectors
signals.summary: InMemory and SqliteVec connectors publish with mismatched transitive dependency versions of Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces, causing MSB3277 build warnings and a FileLoadException at runtime when async interfaces are used.
signals.review_reason: This is a packaging/publishing defect that causes complete runtime failure (FileLoadException) for .NET Framework users of the InMemory and SqliteVec connectors. The error is deterministic and blocks any async operation through these connectors. The root cause is identified as the team publishing packages without versioning their full transitive dependency closure.

source_issues.title: .Net: Bug: Assembly conflicts when referencing `Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.InMemory`
source_issues.evidence: Full MSB3277 warning with detailed assembly binding logs, followed by a FileLoadException at runtime when async interfaces are invoked. Repro project attached as ZIP. Root cause identified by reporter as incorrect package versioning/publishing strategy.

signals.topic: .NET: Fixed version (1.75.0) of PgVector connector missing from NuGet Gallery, blocking users from accessing bugfix
signals.summary: The PgVector connector version 1.75.0 containing a VectorSearchOptions fix is not published to NuGet Gallery, leaving users stuck on 1.74.0-preview with an unresolved bug and no upgrade path.
signals.review_reason: Users are blocked from accessing a known fix because the fixed version was never published to NuGet. This is an infrastructure/release management gap with direct user impact — users cannot resolve their VectorSearchOptions error despite a fix existing. While only 1 issue is filed, the root cause may affect additional connectors.

source_issues.title: .Net: Missing version on Nuget Gallery for Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.PgVector
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly reports encountering a VectorSearchOptions error that is fixed in 1.75.0, but that version is absent from NuGet Gallery, leaving no available upgrade path. This is an infrastructure gap blocking a known fix from reaching users.

signals.topic: iOS mobile thread hydration failure — users cannot open existing sessions on ChatGPT mobile
signals.summary: When using the ChatGPT iOS app to remotely control Codex Desktop, existing threads fail to hydrate their message list, displaying only metadata but no conversation content. Users are blocked from resuming or reviewing past sessions via mobile.
aliases: iOS mobile thread fails to load
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：iOS 用户通过移动端查看历史会话时消息列表完全空白，无法恢复或查看已有会话。这直接阻断了移动端远程控制 Codex 的核心使用场景。issue 提供了清晰的复现步骤和日志证据，错误码 CodexClientError error 11 可定位，session metadata 可见说明连接成功但消息层失败，用户影响明确。

source_issues.title: iOS mobile thread opens with metadata but message hydration fails: CodexClientError error 11
source_issues.evidence: The ChatGPT iOS Codex mobile control UI can open a local desktop thread far enough to display thread metadata, but fails to hydrate the message list. The session is shown but no messages are visible.

signals.topic: Remote control setup fails with 'Failed to authorize remote control' error, blocking device pairing
signals.summary: Users cannot authorize remote control on Codex Desktop. After clicking 'Authorize on chatgpt.com' in the connection settings panel, the authorization fails with a generic error, preventing mobile-device-to-desktop pairing.
aliases: cannot pair devices via remote control
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：remote control 是 Codex Desktop 的核心功能，用户无法完成授权则设备配对完全无法进行，核心功能不可用。issue 提供了完整的复现步骤，5步即可触发，SSH 配置正常说明是 auth 层的独立问题，用户影响明确且可复现。

source_issues.title: Failed to authorize remote control
source_issues.evidence: Codex Desktop shows 'Failed to authorize remote control' error after pressing 'Authorize on chatgpt.com' button in the connections panel. Remote control setup flow is completely broken.

signals.topic: VS Code extension sidebar enters corrupted state after sending empty edited message, becoming unusable
signals.summary: After editing a previous message to empty and sending it, the Codex VS Code extension sidebar becomes permanently corrupted: selected model resets to 'Custom', new messages cannot be sent, and the Codex process reports unavailable. Only a full restart resolves it.
aliases: VS Code sidebar unusable after empty message send
sidebar crashes after editing message to empty
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：VS Code 扩展在发送空编辑消息后进入不可用状态，模型选择变为 Custom 且无法发送新消息，用户必须完全重启扩展才能恢复。这是典型的状态腐败导致扩展完全失效的问题，CLI 仍正常说明是 extension 前端状态问题，用户影响明确且复现路径清晰（5步）。

source_issues.title: Codex VS Code sidebar breaks after editing a previous message to empty and sending
source_issues.evidence: After editing a previous message to empty and sending it, the Codex sidebar enters a corrupted state: selected model becomes 'Custom', new messages cannot be sent, and Codex process reports unavailable. The Codex CLI still works normally, isolating the issue to the VS Code extension.

signals.topic: Codex Computer Use crashes on macOS 15.x due to undocumented Swift symbol dependency on macOS 26.0
signals.summary: Codex Computer Use fails to launch on macOS 15 (Sequoia) because it has a hard, undocumented dependency on macOS 26.0's Swift concurrency library. The dyld error prevents Computer Use from functioning at all on pre-26.0 macOS versions.
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：Computer Use 是 Codex 的核心差异化功能，但在 macOS 15.x 上完全无法启动（dyld crash）。这是一个严重的版本兼容性问题，且完全无文档说明，用户完全无法预期该限制，导致付费功能在大多数 macOS 版本上不可用。用户影响明确（crash + 功能不可用），系统日志提供了 dyld 级别的技术证据。

source_issues.title: Computer Use has an undocumented hard requirement on macOS 26.0
source_issues.evidence: dyld error: 'Symbol not found: _swift_task_addPriorityEscalationHandler' in Codex Computer Use.app on macOS 15.x. Computer Use fails to start entirely.

signals.topic: Orphaned Codex connections persist on iOS after revocation and reinstallation, cannot be deleted or re-paired
signals.summary: After revoking remote control access via Codex Desktop, the connection entries remain visible on the ChatGPT iOS app even after deleting and reinstalling the app. Users cannot delete these stale connections from the iOS UI, and cannot re-pair their devices.
aliases: stale connections not removed after revocation
orphaned iOS connections block device pairing
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用 + 主流程阻断：用户撤销权限后，连接记录仍然幽灵般存在于 iOS 端，且应用重装都无法清除。用户无法通过 UI 删除这些孤立连接，也无法重新配对设备，导致移动端远程控制功能永久失效。这是一个数据持久化 + UI 缺失的组合问题，用户影响严重且无明显 workaround。

source_issues.title: Revoked remote control access for a device, connections remain on ChatGPT mobile app without a way to delete, cannot pair again
source_issues.evidence: After revoking access via Codex Desktop, two connections remain on iOS app even after deleting and reinstalling the app. There is no UI way to remove them. Attempting to re-pair by scanning QR code does nothing.

signals.topic: SQLite session add_items reports success after metadata write failure, causing silent data loss
signals.summary: AdvancedSQLiteSession.add_items() writes base message rows, commits them, and only then writes message_structure metadata rows. If the structure metadata write fails, the method logs the error and returns without raising, while the just-added messages are either cleaned up or remain invisible to subsequent get_items() calls. Callers cannot reliably determine whether the save succeeded, breaking retry logic.
aliases: AdvancedSQLiteSession add_items returns without raising on metadata failure
signals.review_reason: User-impacting data integrity bug: add_items() returns success while messages are either silently removed by cleanup or remain invisible to get_items(). No exception reaches the caller, so retry logic cannot function correctly. This is a session state corruption that can result in lost conversation history.

source_issues.title: AdvancedSQLiteSession.add_items can report success after structure metadata failure
source_issues.evidence: add_items() returns without raising when _insert_structure_metadata fails; messages are either cleaned up or invisible to get_items() but the call appears successful. Caller retry logic cannot determine whether to retry or stop.

signals.topic: SQLite session delete_branch leaves orphaned messages in database, causing invisible data accumulation
signals.summary: AdvancedSQLiteSession.delete_branch() removes turn_usage and message_structure rows for the deleted branch but leaves the underlying agent_messages rows when those messages were only referenced by that branch. After deletion the messages are invisible to advanced queries but remain in the database indefinitely.
signals.review_reason: User-impacting data integrity bug: branch deletion leaves messages in the database that are permanently invisible to all queries, causing unbounded database growth and audit noise in branch-heavy session workflows. The bug is reproducible with the provided script.

source_issues.title: AdvancedSQLiteSession.delete_branch() leaves branch-only messages in the base table
source_issues.evidence: Repro shows that after delete_branch('branch_only'), agent_messages still contains all 4 messages (including 2 branch-only ones) while message_structure only has the 2 main-branch references. Branch-only messages are orphaned and invisible to queries.

signals.topic: Realtime known tool exception/timeout does not send model-visible output, causing indefinite session hang
signals.summary: RealtimeSession._handle_tool_call() for known tools calls invoke_function_tool() without a try/except. When the tool raises an exception (e.g., ToolTimeoutError with timeout_behavior='raise_exception'), no RealtimeModelSendToolOutput is sent back to the model. The model waits indefinitely (~30 seconds) for a function call result that never arrives, leaving the session appearing to hang.
aliases: Realtime tool timeout does not send output to model
known tool exception leaves model hanging
signals.review_reason: User-blocking realtime workflow issue: known tool failures leave the model in an indefinite wait state (~30 seconds) with no output, timeout, or error signal visible to the model. This completely blocks the realtime conversation flow. A repro script demonstrates the issue end-to-end.

source_issues.title: Realtime known tool failures (exception/timeout) do not send model-visible output
source_issues.evidence: Repro shows Model received tool output: False after a known tool raises ValueError. The model is left waiting for ~30 seconds until server-side timeout. The existing test at test_session.py:1199 codifies this missing-output behavior as expected, meaning it was an unintended but existing behavior.

signals.topic: Realtime approval uses bare tool name instead of qualified lookup key for namespaced tools
signals.summary: RealtimeSession approval reuse checks only the bare tool name (e.g., 'lookup_account') instead of the qualified lookup key (e.g., 'crm.lookup_account'). For namespaced tools, always=True approval stored under the bare name is not found on subsequent calls, causing the approval to be ignored and the tool call to be re-presented for approval.
aliases: Realtime namespaced tool always-approval ignored on second call
signals.review_reason: User-experience degradation for realtime namespaced tool workflows: always-approval is silently ignored on namespaced tools after the first call, causing the same tool call to require approval repeatedly instead of being automatically allowed. This breaks a core approval UX promise for namespaced tools.

source_issues.title: Realtime approvals should use qualified tool lookup keys
source_issues.evidence: Repro shows approval_keys: ['lookup_account'] (bare name) when it should be 'crm.lookup_account'. The second call to the same namespaced tool sends 2 tool_outputs instead of skipping the second call due to always-approval.

signals.topic: RealtimeSession cleanup cancels background tasks without awaiting them, leaking task state
signals.summary: RealtimeSession._cleanup() cancels pending guardrail and tool-call background tasks with task.cancel() but does not await the cancelled tasks before clearing the tracking sets. This means finally blocks do not run, cancellation exceptions are not collected, and task callbacks can be processed after the session has moved on to model close.
aliases: Realtime session cleanup does not await cancelled tasks
signals.review_reason: User-experience degradation: realtime session cleanup can return before cancelled task finally blocks have executed, potentially leaving cleanup callbacks (e.g., resource release, logging) unrun and causing inconsistent session shutdown state.

source_issues.title: Realtime cleanup should await cancelled background tasks
source_issues.evidence: Repro shows guardrail_done_after_cleanup: False and tool_done_after_cleanup: False immediately after _cleanup() returns, while tracked_task sets are already cleared. Cancelled task finally blocks did not run.

signals.topic: Streaming tool_call delta accumulation fails to merge duplicate index entries, corrupting tool call arguments in streaming mode
signals.summary: When streaming chunks contain multiple tool_call entries with the same `index`, the `accumulate_delta` function stores them as separate list elements instead of merging by index. This produces invalid/malformed JSON in `tool_calls[].function.arguments`, making tool calls unparseable. Root cause: early-return branches in `_deltas.py` skip index-merge logic for first-chunk entries. Same bug exists in `_assistants.py` and `_completions.py`. Actively observed against vLLM with speculative decoding enabled.
aliases: streaming tool_calls duplicate index merge bug
signals.review_reason: Two confirmed bug reports with reproduction code, both with 'bug' label. The issue causes data corruption in a core streaming path (tool_call arguments become invalid JSON), directly breaking the tool-calling workflow. Actively observed in production with vLLM speculative decoding. Count=2 meets the frequency threshold.

source_issues.title: `accumulate_delta` drops tool_call fragments when one chunk has multiple entries at the same `index`
source_issues.evidence: Bug causes JSON arguments to be split across two orphaned list entries, making final tool_call.arguments unparseable as JSON. Reproduction code shows malformed output: `arguments == ': "London"}'` instead of `{"city": "London"}`. Node SDK has the same bug. Affects vLLM with speculative decoding.

source_issues.title: Streaming tool_call deltas with duplicate indexes in first chunk are accumulated incorrectly
source_issues.evidence: First chunk with two index:0 entries results in orphaned second entry. Final tool_calls array has two physical entries both with index:0. Arguments are corrupted and invalid JSON. Root cause confirmed in _deltas.py. Multiple comments confirming the issue.

signals.topic: Responses API multi-turn conversations 400 on turn 2 when reusing response.output as input
signals.summary: Passing `response.output` back as `input` via `model_dump()` causes HTTP 400 on turn 2 with error `Unknown parameter: 'input[1].status'`. The `model_dump()` method fabricates null values for fields the API never returned (e.g., `status: None`, `encrypted_content: None`), which the API rejects. Additionally, a pairing constraint requires reasoning+message to be consecutive, which is undocumented. Affects production users doing multi-turn conversations by manually assembling history.
signals.review_reason: Despite count=1, this is a P0 because: (1) it completely breaks a core multi-turn conversation pattern that is the intuitive/expected usage, (2) it has massive downstream blast radius (64.9k fork repo OpenClaw confirmed broken, plus Agents SDK and Pydantic-AI), (3) root cause is confirmed (model_dump fabricating nulls + pairing constraint), and (4) the workaround requires abandoning the manual history approach entirely.

source_issues.title: Responses API: multi-turn conversations 400 on turn 2 when passing response.output back as input
source_issues.evidence: Multi-turn conversation workflow completely blocked on turn 2. Affects multiple downstream projects: OpenClaw (64.9k forks, production breakage), Agents SDK, Pydantic-AI. Issue linked to openai/openai-openapi#536 (spec root cause, open since Aug 2025) and openai/openai-node#1791 (same bug in TypeScript). Workaround exists (`previous_response_id`) but requires API call pattern change. Confirmed by 3+ comments and cross-referenced issues.

signals.topic: v2.34.0 breaking change: empty api_key string raises OpenAIError, breaking OpenAI-compatible local servers
signals.summary: In v2.34.0, `AsyncOpenAI(api_key="")` raises `OpenAIError: Missing credentials`, breaking all users who use the SDK to connect to local OpenAI-compatible servers (llama.cpp, llamafile, LM Studio, vLLM, etc.) that do not require authentication. In v2.33.0 and earlier, empty string was silently accepted. New credential validation logic (`not self.api_key` for empty string) is the root cause. Users must pass a non-empty placeholder string as workaround.
signals.review_reason: Count=1 but this is a clear regression from v2.33.0 to v2.34.0 that breaks a common and legitimate use case (local server development). While not multi-turn conversational flow, it directly blocks local development and testing workflows which are critical for developer experience. Downgrade from P0 due to count=1 threshold, but user impact is well-documented.

source_issues.title: AsyncOpenAI(api_key="") raises OpenAIError in v2.34.0, breaking OpenAI-compatible local servers
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed breaking change from v2.33.0 to v2.34.0. Affects all local server users (llama.cpp, llamafile, LM Studio, vLLM). The workaround (passing placeholder string) is described as 'surprising' since empty string worked in all prior versions. Scope: all platforms (Linux/macOS/Windows). New credential validation logic confirmed as root cause.

signals.topic: Responses API reasoning summary events not emitted in streaming mode for codex model variants
signals.summary: When calling the Responses API with `streaming=True` and `reasoning={"effort": "high", "summary": "auto"}`, the codex model variants (gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.1-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-max) never emit `response.reasoning_summary_part.added`, `response.reasoning_summary_text.delta`, or `response.reasoning_summary_part.done` events during code-generation prompts. The stream goes directly from request to `response.output_text.delta` with no reasoning summary in between. The same code works correctly on gpt-5-mini.
aliases: reasoning summary events missing codex streaming
signals.review_reason: Key Responses API feature (streaming reasoning summaries) is completely non-functional for codex model family while working for other models. This is a clear functional gap that affects a core feature of the reasoning effort parameter. Count=1 prevents P0, but the selective failure across model families indicates a real regression in expected behavior.

source_issues.title: `summary="auto"` produces no reasoning summary events on `gpt-5.3-codex` (Responses API, streaming)
source_issues.evidence: Confirmed bug with codex variants: gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.1-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-max all fail to emit reasoning summary events. Same code works on gpt-5-mini. User-facing key feature (reasoning summary) completely absent for specific model family. 1 comment indicating community attention.

signals.topic: Structured Output parsing intermittently raises unhandled ValidationError in production
signals.summary: Using `client.beta.chat.completions.parse()` with structured output schemas intermittently raises an unhandled `ValidationError` (Pydantic JSON parsing error). The error occurs non-deterministically in production and results in unhandled exception crashes. The error shows `Invalid JSON: EOF while parsing a value` indicating incomplete or truncated JSON responses from the API.
aliases: structured output intermittent JSON parsing error
signals.review_reason: Despite count=1, this is a high-impact issue: open for 8+ months, 21 comments from affected users, occurs in production non-deterministically, and raises an unhandled exception that crashes the calling application. The root cause (API returning truncated/incomplete JSON for structured outputs) is clearly identified. Downgrade to P1 only because count=1 and this could be partially server-side.

source_issues.title: beta.chat.completions.parse returns unhandled ValidationError
source_issues.evidence: 21 comments, open since September 2024. Issue describes intermittent but recurring unhandled ValidationError in production service using structured outputs. Error is `json_invalid` type from Pydantic, meaning API returned incomplete JSON. User states 'unpredictable behavior is hard to prevent' in production. Multiple users have commented experiencing the same issue.

signals.topic: Example references non-existent create_triage_agent function
signals.summary: The personal_shopper example imports create_triage_agent from swarm.agents, but agents.py does not exist in the swarm package, causing immediate import errors for users running the documented examples.
signals.review_reason: Users following the documented examples encounter an immediate import error because create_triage_agent is referenced but the underlying agents.py module does not exist. This blocks the primary onboarding flow (running the provided examples). Although count=1, the evidence shows a direct example code breakage with a clear root cause (missing file), warranting P1 priority.

source_issues.title: no create_triage_agent
source_issues.evidence: User reported that examples/personal_shopper/main.py imports from swarm.agents import create_triage_agent, but no agents.py exists under the swarm folder, causing immediate import failure.

signals.topic: Multiple publishers locked out of ClawHub with skills disappearing from marketplace
signals.summary: A systemic incident affecting multiple publishers: accounts become inaccessible via GitHub OAuth login, and all previously-published skills vanish from the marketplace (API returns 'Skill not found', publisher profile shows 404). Affected publishers are completely blocked — they cannot log in, cannot manage skills, and their published work is gone. Several accounts also cannot re-register after accidental deletion.
signals.review_reason: 高频(count=8) + 主流程阻断：多publisher账户无法登录+技能全部消失，属于平台级incident。直接影响：无法管理已发布技能、无法登录、API token被撤销、部分账户被永久封禁无法重新注册。8个独立issue均提供API验证证据（GET返回Skill not found、401 Unauthorized）。符合P0条件。

source_issues.title: All my skills disappeared from ClawHub + can't login (publisher: liuboacean)
source_issues.evidence: All 4 published skills gone ('Skill not found'), publisher page 404, GitHub OAuth login has no response, CLI login cannot complete OAuth flow. Publisher page https://clawhub.ai/liuboacean shows 'We couldn't find that page.'

source_issues.title: Request to Restore My ClawHub Account
source_issues.evidence: Cannot log in after GitHub sign-in, previously published skills no longer findable in marketplace. Business impact on ongoing projects.

source_issues.title: Request to restore paulgnz account access and skill visibility
source_issues.evidence: 8 previously published skills gone + 2 skills published on May 12 gone. `clawhub whoami` returns 'Unauthorized: API token is invalid or revoked'. `GET https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/skills/xpr-network-dev` returns 'Skill not found'. GitHub sign-in produces no popup.

source_issues.title: Request to unban my GitHub account for re‑registering ClawHub
source_issues.evidence: After accidental ClawHub account deletion, GitHub account permanently blocked from re-registering due to a 'purged' mark. User relies on ClawHub for Hermes-Agent/Feishu integration. Cannot create new account.

source_issues.title: Skills not attributed to account after reinstatement — login broken + API token revoked
source_issues.evidence: After account reinstatement (from ban), 3 problems persist: (1) profile shows 0 published/0 downloads/0 stars despite skills returning 200 at direct URLs; (2) login fails silently; (3) API token returns 401 Unauthorized and cannot be regenerated because login is broken. Double lockout.

source_issues.title: Publisher access request for @neurarelay package namespace
source_issues.evidence: Publisher account @neurarelay cannot be published under — appears treated as personal publisher instead of org, preventing correct namespace publish. Distinct from ban but related access model issue.

source_issues.title: Deleted skill slug remains unavailable and cannot be merged across owners
source_issues.evidence: After skill deletion, slug remains reserved. Cannot rename another skill to the deleted slug. UI suggests use merge, but merge is unavailable across different entities. Deleted skill does not appear in merge options. Blocks publisher workflow for slug reuse.

source_issues.title: Clarify public v1 API error responses
source_issues.evidence: API error paths return plain text (text/plain) instead of JSON. Clients cannot reliably distinguish error types programmatically. Affects all public API consumers including CLI and third-party integrations building on ClawHub.

signals.topic: GitHub OAuth login broken — CSP blocks eval() / OAuth callback missing code parameter
signals.summary: The 'Sign in with GitHub' button on clawhub.ai fails to trigger any action in some cases (CSP blocking eval()) and in other cases the OAuth callback redirects to app root without appending the exchange code, preventing session creation. Existing publishers cannot access their dashboard, and locked-out users cannot regain access. This is part of the broader account lockout incident.
aliases: Sign in with GitHub button broken
signals.review_reason: 认证流程阻断：GitHub OAuth登录在两种场景下失败（CSP blocking eval + OAuth callback缺code参数），影响3个独立用户。OAuth是ClawHub唯一登录方式，登录失败意味着publisher完全无法使用平台。3个issue各自独立提供调试证据（DevTools console、网络请求0次触发、localStorage缺JWT）。属于P1主流程阻断。

source_issues.title: Sign in with GitHub button does not trigger any action — CSP blocks eval()
source_issues.evidence: Clicking 'Sign in with GitHub' produces 0 network requests. Chrome DevTools Issues tab: 'Content Security Policy of your site blocks the use of eval in JavaScript'. CSP forbids eval() but login handler uses it. Verified in incognito (no extensions), cleared cookies, multiple browsers. Existing publisher `hongping-zh` blocked from dashboard. Regression: `ecocompute` v3.0.8 was published via web UI just a day before.

source_issues.title: GitHub OAuth callback redirects to app root without exchange code, preventing login
source_issues.evidence: GitHub OAuth callback reaches Convex (https://wry-manatee-359.convex.site/api/auth/callback/github?code=...) with PKCE cookie, but redirects to https://clawhub.ai/ without ?code=... or ?error=.... AuthCodeHandler never receives a code, no JWT/refresh token stored in localStorage. User cannot complete login.

source_issues.title: Skills not attributed to account after reinstatement — login broken + API token revoked
source_issues.evidence: Post-reinstatement, login attempt fails silently. API token returns 401. Login broken is one of 3 persistent problems after account reinstatement, confirmed by `[CONVEX M(users:ensure)] Server Error` in browser console during failed sign-in.

signals.topic: Legitimate skills incorrectly flagged as malicious/suspicious by automated security scanner (false positives)
signals.summary: Multiple legitimate, non-malicious skills are being flagged as suspicious/malicious by the ClawHub automated security scanner. This blocks them from the marketplace: they become invisible in search and cannot be published or re-published. Affected skills include markdown2doc (document conversion tool) and AIDEX (Web3 trading tool whose autonomous architecture is misread as a vulnerability). Appeal processes are slow and the flags can recur even after being lifted.
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：安全扫描假阳性导致合法skill被标记为恶意，阻止其出现在市场中。影响publisher的核心发布权和marketplace可见性。3个独立issue（markdown2docappeal二次被误标、AIDEX Web3架构被误读、GaodeMap官方技能搜索不可见）均证明扫描器存在系统性假阳性问题。appeal流程耗时长且flag会反复出现，P1。

source_issues.title: [Skill Appeal] markdown2doc incorrectly flagged as malicious
source_issues.evidence: markdown2doc (document conversion utility) was confirmed safe by security team in a previous appeal (#2046), but flagged malicious again. Audit findings explicitly state 'no malicious intent, obfuscation, or unauthorized execution' yet the malicious label persists. Second appeal required. Skill blocked from marketplace.

source_issues.title: AIDEX Skill — Manual Verification Request
source_issues.evidence: AIDEX Web3 trading skill flagged for: ASI02 (tool misuse — but blocking confirmation gate would break autonomous workflows), ASI03 (identity/privilege abuse — reading private key locally is self-custody architecture), ASI04 (npm dependencies — ethers is industry-standard). Flag re-occurred after previous version was assessed safe. Manual verification requested to prevent repeated false positives.

source_issues.title: GaodeMapOfficial skills are available but weakly visible for map search
source_issues.evidence: Official Gaode Map skills (amap-lbs-skill, amap-jsapi-skill, amap-cli-skill, personal-map) have no suspicious/malware flags, return 200 on detail API, but are absent from top 50 'map' search results. Official skills with 'Map' in their name should rank higher for 'map' queries. Visibility issue means users cannot discover official skills.

signals.topic: clawhub package publish (code-plugin/bundle-plugin variant) hangs indefinitely with zero output
signals.summary: The `clawhub package publish` command — used for publishing code-plugin and bundle-plugin packages — hangs silently for 30-90 seconds and is killed by SIGKILL, with no progress, no error, and no indication of what went wrong. This completely blocks the code-plugin/bundle-plugin publishing workflow. A workaround exists via `clawhub publish` (skill publishing) but is a different product path.
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：code-plugin发布是ClawHub的核心发布路径之一，hang导致零输出+SIGKILL，用户完全无法判断失败原因。虽然skill publish有workaround，但package publish是独立功能，阻断真实。count=2，有明确复现步骤和调试输出。

source_issues.title: clawhub package publish hangs indefinitely with no output
source_issues.evidence: Process hangs with zero output for 30-90s then SIGKILL. Only `clawhub package publish` (code-plugin/bundle-plugin variant) affected; `clawhub publish` skill variant works. `NODE_DEBUG=*` shows module loading then stalls on the HTTP API call. No error, no timeout, no progress — user is completely blocked.

source_issues.title: Clarify public API query filter behavior
source_issues.evidence: Contains evidence of API-level instability: filter params like `family=not-a-family` silently return 200 with default results instead of an error, misleading clients. Indicates underlying API routing/validation issues that can cause confusing silent failures in API-driven workflows.

signals.topic: Skill slug availability check throws Convex server error, blocking skill publish and new version upload
signals.summary: The Convex query `skills:checkSlugAvailability` returns a server error on the ClawHub UI, preventing users from (1) publishing new skills and (2) uploading new versions of existing skills. The error page ('Something went wrong [CONVEX Q(skills:checkSlugAvailability)] Server Error') appears when clicking 'New version' or when the publish flow reaches slug availability validation.
aliases: skill publish blocked by server error
new version upload fails convex error
